title: Tenant-level egress controls and network gating
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Implement tenant-scoped administrative controls to prevent data exfiltration and accidental exposure. This ticket covers three admin-facing toggles: 1) IP allowlisting (per-tenant ingress gating), 2) Disable public sharing (prevent creation of public share links and embeddings that can be externally fetched), and 3) Block data export (prevent bulk export/download of user content and model outputs). These controls must be enforceable across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments and surface in the Console and Control Plane API.

Scope:
- Backend enforcement middleware for ingress (IP gating) that integrates with smart routing and the runtime layer.
- Administrative API and Console UI elements guarded by RBAC v2 roles.
- Persistent, immutable audit events for every toggle read/change and enforcement decision.
- Migration path for existing org-level settings and a staged rollout plan with telemetry.

Non-goals:
- Fine-grained per-resource exports inside customer data stores (out of scope; rely on existing storage controls).
- Deep SIEM connector implementation (we will provide webhook events; SIEM integration tracked in follow-up ticket).

Security considerations:
- Changes must require Org Admin or Security Admin role in new RBAC v2. SAML SSO org assertions must map to those roles.
- Audit events must include before/after values, actor identity (SSO subject), IP, and deployment context.
- Toggle enforcement must be resilient to downstream failures (fallback behavior: deny by default when enforcement check fails).

Rollout plan:
- Phase 1 (canary orgs): backend enforcement + API toggles + audit logs, no Console exposure.
- Phase 2: Console UI + migration/import tool for existing org flags.
- Phase 3: Broad rollout + telemetry dashboards and alerting for enforcement spikes and false positives.

Acceptance criteria: see acceptance_criteria field.

acceptance_criteria: Admin UI exposes three toggles: IP allowlist, disable-public-sharing, block-data-exports.
API and private control plane enforce toggles for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments.
RBAC v2 roles required to change toggles: Org Admin or Security Admin (asserted via SSO/SAML mappings).
All toggle reads/changes and enforcement decisions produce immutable audit events that include actor, timestamp, before/after values, and request context.
Migration tool/import path provided for existing org settings; canary rollout executed and monitored for 2 weeks with defined rollback criteria.
notes: Prototype uses nginx-style allowlist middleware for request ingress checks; long-term perf plan is to integrate with smart routing layer for zero-hop evaluation.
Audit events will be written to immutable store and exported to BigQuery; customers with advanced compliance add-on can subscribe to webhook SIEM forwarder.
Consider adding a scoped "emergency-suspend" toggle for SRE to temporarily relax egress when customer availability is at risk; requires separate approval flow.
